## Century Communities to Host November Grand Opening for Six Model Homes at Two New Florence, AZ Communities


November 18, 2026


New homes in Florence, AZ are priced from the low $300s—with quick move-in, under-construction, and to-be-built options—in a rapidly growing Southeast Valley location near San Tan Valley


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Two Communities. Three Home Collections. Six Models. One Grand Opening Experience:** Homebuyers can tour six model homes across two new Florence, AZ communities (with a combined three new home collections) on Saturday, November 21, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.
- **Strategic Southeast Valley expansion:** Sage Grove at Magma Ranch, The Vistas Collection at Silver Cross, and The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross add more than 275 new single-family homesites in Florence, extending Century Communities' presence in the Southeast Valley, with convenient proximity to San Tan Valley.
- **Attainable opportunity in a growth market:** Pricing from the low $300s and USDA loan eligibility give homebuyers a new entry point in the Phoenix-Tucson corridor.
- **Product breadth for evolving demand:** Single- and two-story floor plans range from 1,299 to 2,935 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms and 2 to 3 bathrooms.
- **Flexible move times:** Quick move-in homes, homes under construction, and to-be-built homesites give buyers options based on their preferred timing.
- **Planned amenities add long-term value:** Sage Grove at Magma Ranch will feature thoughtfully designed future amenities, including parks, sports courts, a playground, a splash pad, and outdoor gathering spaces. At Silver Cross, a park, pickleball and tennis courts, trails, a playground, and a resort-style pool with a deck are planned.


FLORENCE, Ariz.


, Nov. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced a multi-community Grand Opening event in November for two new communities in Florence, AZ: Sage Grove at Magma Ranch (single-family homes from the low $300s), and Silver Cross, comprised of The Vistas Collection (single-family homes from the low $300s), and The Foothills Collection (single-family homes from the upper $300s). In addition, each community will offer exciting future amenities designed for recreation and connection, such as sports courts, parks, gathering spaces, and water features.


**GRAND OPENING DETAILS**


The combined Grand Opening event for Sage Grove at Magma Ranch, The Vistas Collection at Silver Cross, and The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross will take place on Saturday, November 21, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. Prospective homebuyers can tour six stunning models, explore under-construction homes, check out quick move-in listings, and learn about to-be-built homesites—all spanning three home collections, with single- and two-story floor plans ranging from 1,299 to 2,935 square feet.


All three neighborhoods are located approximately five minutes apart, and attendees will have the chance to win prizes by stamping a tour passport as they visit each model home. Local sales teams will be on hand to answer questions and schedule private appointments.


Guests are invited to check in for their tours and receive their passports at:
The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross
26226 N. Brown Vine Street
Florence, AZ 85132


**RSVP for the event at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/FlorenceRSVP](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826254-1&h=3153275429&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FFlorenceRSVP&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FFlorenceRSVP)


"We're excited to introduce an exceptional new community and two versatile home collections in Florence that combine thoughtfully designed homes, meaningful community amenities, and attainable pricing in one of Arizona's fastest-growing areas," said Division President Taylor Lilly. "Opening a new community and two new floor plan collections on the same day provides a unique opportunity for buyers to explore each location in a single afternoon and find their best fit."


Sage Grove at Magma Ranch, The Vistas Collection at Silver Cross, and The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross pair Florence's small-town pace with easy access to the East Valley. Located in North Florence near Hunt Highway, the neighborhoods are close to Queen Creek and San Tan Valley, with convenient access to East Valley employment, shopping, and recreation. Everyday shopping, dining, and services are minutes away, with Queen Creek Marketplace, QC District, and the open-air shops at SanTan Village a short drive north.


Outdoor recreation is also within easy reach at Poston Butte Golf Club and San Tan Mountain Regional Park, while downtown Florence offers local restaurants, McFarland State Historic Park, and the Viney Jones Library.


Sage Grove at Magma Ranch and both Silver Cross collections will offer new homes that include flexible spaces like lofts and private studies (per plan), the Century Home Connect® smart home package, Cosentino® quartz countertops in kitchen and baths, front yard landscaping (with backyard packages available), LG® stainless-steel kitchen appliances, Kohler® faucets, and more. Both Silver Cross collections are also in USDA-eligible locations.

**THE FREEDOM OF ONLINE** **HOMEBUYING**


Century Communities is proud to feature its industry-first online homebuying experience on available homes in Arizona, allowing homebuyers to easily find their best fit and purchase when they're ready—all while continuing to work with their local real estate agent of choice. Homebuyers can further streamline the homebuying process by financing online with Century Communities' affiliate lender, Inspire Home Loans®.


**How it works:**


1. Shop homes at CenturyCommunities.com
2. Click "Buy Now" on any available home
3. Fill out a quick Buy Online form
4. Electronically submit an initial earnest money deposit
5. Electronically sign a purchase contract via DocuSign®


Learn more about the Buy Online experience at[www.CenturyCommunities.com/online-homebuying](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826254-1&h=1669603441&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**When will the Grand Opening take place for Magma Ranch and Silver Cross in Florence, AZ?**
Century Communities is hosting the multi-community Grand Opening on Saturday, November 21, 20026, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., with initial check-in at The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross (26226 N. Brown Vine Street, Florence, AZ 85132). Guests can tour six model homes across Sage Grove at Magma Ranch, The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross, and The Vistas Collection at Silver Cross.


**How much do new homes cost at Sage Grove at Magma Ranch and Silver Cross in Florence, AZ?**
Homes start in the low $300s at Sage Grove at Magma Ranch, the low $300s at The Vistas Collection at Silver Cross, and the upper $300s at The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross. Starting prices reflect current availability.


**Are new homes at Silver Cross in Florence, AZ USDA-eligible?**
Both Silver Cross collections, The Foothills Collection and The Vistas Collection, are in USDA-eligible locations. Buyers must qualify for USDA financing.


**How far apart are Sage Grove at Magma Ranch and Silver Cross in Florence, AZ?**
The two communities are about five minutes apart in North Florence near Hunt Highway. Queen Creek is 15 to 20 minutes away, with San Tan Valley just to the north.


**How big are the new homes at Magma Ranch and Silver Cross?**
Floor plans range from 1,299 to 2,377 square feet at Sage Grove at Magma Ranch, 1,585 to 2,377 square feet at The Vistas Collection at Silver Cross and 1,914 to 2,935 square feet at The Foothills Collection at Silver Cross. All three offer one- and two-story homes with 2-car garages.


**Can buyers move in soon at Magma Ranch and Silver Cross in Florence, AZ?**
Guests at the November 21, 2026 Grand Opening can see quick move-in homes, homes under construction and to-be-built homesites. Local sales teams are on hand to answer questions and schedule private appointments.
